subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Procurement & Security Next Steps
messages:
From: Marc Tully <marc.tully@acme-fintech.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Procurement & Security Next Steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the demo today, it was really helpful. A couple quick items from my side as we try to lock timelines down: 

- Economic buyer is our Head of Engineering, Nina Alvarez — she'll want a short ROI slide and a rough TCO.
- Procurement needs our vendor onboarding packet (W-9, corporate info) and the standard SOW/term sheet.
- Legal (Sarah on cc) wants to confirm data residency and SOC 2 evidence before we can sign.
- PO process: Procurement requires a signed SOW + vendor form. Typical cycle is ~2–3 weeks once we have the SOW and onboarding packet.

Can Redwood send the vendor packet and a draft SOW we can review? Also, can you confirm who at Redwood will be the three main contacts (billing, security, technical) for our vendor form?

Best,
Marc
Marc Tully
Director, Platform Partnerships
Acme Fintech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Procurement & Security Next Steps

Marc — thanks for the clear summary and for looping in Sarah. Great to know Nina is the economic buyer; we'll put together a one-pager ROI/TCO.

Next steps from Redwood: 
1) Attaching our standard vendor onboarding checklist (Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf) and a draft SOW for your procurement team to review.
2) Rishi (copied) will be the technical contact and can help with SOC 2 items / evidence.
3) Vanessa (cc) will be the billing contact for PO / invoicing questions.

Can you confirm the preferred invoicing cadence (Net 30 / Net 45) and the billing contact for issuing the PO? Also, is there a preferred template for the vendor form or should we use your procurement@acme-fintech.com process?

I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up with Nina + Sarah if that helps accelerate approvals — earliest availability is next Wed/Thu.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Date: 2026-08-26T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Procurement & Security Next Steps

Hi Sarah / Marc —

Quick note on the security artifacts you asked about:
- Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II; I can share the SOC 2 summary report and a read-only access link to the full report under an NDA.
- Data residency: for hosted customers we provide region-based routing; for regulated workloads we offer Private deployments (VPC/on-prem). For Acme’s use case we recommend "us-east" region with customer pinning to avoid cross-region routing.
- If you need any architecture diagrams or sample network configs for your vendor questionnaire, I can send those by EOD Thursday.

Also tagging Vanessa for billing cadence recommendations — we normally support Net 30, Net 45 on request, and can invoice on monthly or milestone schedules depending on SOW.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marc Tully <marc.tully@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-fintech.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Procurement & Security Next Steps

Thanks — Marissa/Rishi. A few clarifying questions from Legal: 

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood will act as a subprocessor for any third-party analytics vendors? If yes, list them.
2) Do you retain any customer data for debugging / telemetry by default? If so, what is the retention window and how is it access-controlled?
3) We will need the SOC 2 summary and your incident response playbook for our security intake.

If you can provide answers and artifacts by Friday it will keep us on the 2–3 week procurement timetable. Also, please include a contact for contract redlines (who should we send the SOW/terms back to?).

Regards,
Sarah Kim
Senior Counsel, Acme Fintech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marc Tully <marc.tully@acme-fintech.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@acme-fintech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-fintech.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Procurement & Security Next Steps

Sarah / Marc — quick status update and attachments:

- Attached: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf and SOW-draft-Acme-2026.docx (please review and send any redlines back to contracts@redwood.com).
- Answers to Sarah’s questions: 
  * Subprocessors: We use a small set of cloud providers for hosting and a telemetry aggregator for product health; I’ve attached a subprocessors list (see onboarding checklist page 3).
  * Data retention: Defaults are 30 days for request logs and anonymized telemetry; customer-controlled retention is available for Private deployments — Rishi can follow up with architecture specifics.
  * SOC 2: Rishi will share the SOC 2 summary via secure link once NDA is in place.

- Contacts for your forms: Billing / PO — Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com). Technical / security — Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com). Contract redlines — contracts@redwood.com.

Timeline suggestion: if Acme returns the SOW with minor redlines by next Tue (Sept 7), procurement can issue a PO by Sept 18 and kickoff onboarding the following week. That aligns with a ~3-week procurement cycle.

Would you like me to schedule a 30-min call with Nina (economic buyer), Sarah (legal) and our team (Rishi, Vanessa) to review the SOW and onboarding checklist? I have availability Sept 2–3.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, SOW-draft-Acme-2026.docx
